summary: Established a manual file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (Alpine 3.23, AIDE unavailable in repos) using a custom baseline/check script pair recording path|type|mode|uid|gid|size|mtime|sha256(or symlink target) for every file, dir, and symlink under /etc, protected by its own checksum manifest. Verified detection works (modify+add test), reverted the test changes, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id, rebooted node1 via `reboot` with a background-delayed ack, polled until reachable, confirmed a new boot_id/uptime, and confirmed post-restart service health plus that the baseline manifest and /etc integrity check both passed cleanly.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Alpine 3.23.3) and confirmed AIDE/tripwire/samhain are not packaged for this repo

Wrote /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-baseline.sh to build /var/lib/etc-integrity/baseline.tsv (path|type|mode|uid|gid|size|mtime|hash) for all /etc files/dirs/symlinks plus a sha256 manifest of the baseline itself
Wrote /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity-check.sh to rebuild current state and diff against baseline.tsv, reporting ADDED/REMOVED/MODIFIED entries
Ran the baseline generator (377 entries captured) and confirmed a clean check with no changes
Injected a real test change (modified /etc/motd, added /etc/integrity-test-newfile.txt) and confirmed the check detected all three deltas, then reverted them and confirmed a clean check again
Captured pre-restart boot_id (e3f17a40...) and service status via rc-status
Rebooted node1 with an ack-first backgrounded `reboot` command
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming new boot_id (da6e4515...) and fresh uptime
Post-restart verified rc-status services started, baseline manifest sha256 still verifies OK, and etc-integrity-check.sh reports a clean /etc state

evidence.requirement: Establish an /etc integrity baseline on node1
evidence.summary: Baseline generator created /var/lib/etc-integrity/baseline.tsv with 377 recorded /etc entries (path, type, mode, uid, gid, size, mtime, sha256/symlink target) plus a sha256 manifest of the baseline file

evidence.requirement: Baseline correctly represents current state and can detect later changes
evidence.summary: Check script ran clean on unchanged /etc, then correctly flagged MODIFIED /etc, MODIFIED /etc/motd, and ADDED /etc/integrity-test-newfile.txt after a deliberate test change; after reverting the change, the check returned clean again

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + service health) for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id e3f17a40-7341-44b3-8171-60ffe075248f and rc-status showing networking/chronyd/vsock-agent/sshd all started prior to restart

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, node1 restarted one at a time
evidence.summary: Backgrounded delayed reboot command acknowledged immediately (pid returned), subsequent poll showed connection failures confirming the node went down

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: After polling through connection failures, node1 became reachable again with boot_id da6e4515-3fd7-48ad-a371-f2251fdf47ab (different from pre-restart e3f17a40...) and fresh uptime timestamp

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services and integrity baseline data
evidence.summary: rc-status showed networking/chronyd/vsock-agent/sshd started post-restart; baseline.tsv.sha256 verified OK; etc-integrity-check.sh reported a clean /etc state with no differences from baseline
